declare
  v_c    clob;
  v_b    blob;
  v_tmp  clob;
  v_buf  varchar2(4000);
  v_raw  raw(4000);
  v_amt  number;
  v_len  number;
begin
  select c, b into v_c, v_b from mtk_lob where id = 1 for update;
  v_buf := rpad('appended by mtk_lobs scenario ', 4000, 'z');
  v_raw := utl_raw.cast_to_raw(v_buf);
  for i in 1 .. 5 loop
    dbms_lob.writeappend(v_c, length(v_buf), v_buf);
    dbms_lob.writeappend(v_b, utl_raw.length(v_raw), v_raw);
  end loop;
  v_len := dbms_lob.getlength(v_c);
  dbms_output.put_line('clob length after append = ' || v_len);
  v_amt := 4000;
  dbms_lob.read(v_c, v_amt, 1, v_buf);
  dbms_lob.write(v_c, 10, 1, 'OVERWRITE!');
  dbms_lob.createtemporary(v_tmp, true);
  dbms_lob.copy(v_tmp, v_c, 20000);
  dbms_lob.append(v_tmp, v_c);
  dbms_output.put_line('temp lob length = ' || dbms_lob.getlength(v_tmp));
  dbms_lob.freetemporary(v_tmp);
  rollback;   -- keep the fixture data unchanged
end;

SELECT o.name 
FROM
 (SELECT :1 as obj# FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT d.d_obj# as obj# FROM 
  dependency$ d JOIN obj$ o ON d.d_obj# = o.obj# AND o.type# = 5 START WITH 
  d.p_obj# = :1 CONNECT BY PRIOR d.d_obj# = d.p_obj# ) bo, obj$ o, 
  dependency$ d, jsonmap_view$ j WHERE d.p_obj# = bo.obj# AND d.d_obj# = 
  j.obj# AND bitand(j.flags,1)=1 AND o.status NOT IN (3,5) AND o.obj# = 
  j.obj# FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SQL ID: 121ffmrc95v7g Plan Hash: 2007068531

select i.obj#,i.ts#,i.file#,i.block#,i.intcols,i.type#,i.flags,i.property,
  i.pctfree$,i.initrans,i.maxtrans,i.blevel,i.leafcnt,i.distkey,i.lblkkey,
  i.dblkkey,i.clufac,i.cols,i.analyzetime,i.samplesize,i.dataobj#,
  nvl(i.degree,1),nvl(i.instances,1),i.rowcnt,mod(i.pctthres$,256),
  i.indmethod#,i.trunccnt,nvl(c.unicols,0),nvl(c.deferrable#+c.valid#,0),
  nvl(i.spare1,i.intcols),i.spare4,i.spare2,i.spare6,decode(i.pctthres$,null,
  null,mod(trunc(i.pctthres$/256),256)),nvl(i.evaledition#,1),
  nvl(i.unusablebefore#,0),nvl(i.unusablebeginning#,0), ist.cachedblk,
  ist.cachehit,ist.logicalread 
from
 ind$ i, ind_stats$ ist, (select enabled, min(intcols) unicols,
  min(to_number(bitand(defer,1))) deferrable#,min(to_number(bitand(defer,4))) 
  valid# from cdef$ where obj#=:1 and enabled > 1 group by enabled) c where 
  i.obj#=c.enabled(+) and i.obj# = ist.obj#(+) and i.bo#=:1 order by i.obj#
